PayloadTooLarge.description: Request exceeds the Gateway transport limit. Reduce the request size or use bulk upsert when supported.

BadGateway.description: Unexpected downstream failure. A failed write response may leave its outcome uncertain.

ServiceUnavailable.description: Transient catalog or storage dependency failure. Use bounded retries where the operation permits.

GatewayTimeout.description: Gateway request deadline exceeded. A write may have been applied; verify its outcome before retrying.

CatalogConflict.description: Conditional catalog conflict. Refresh the resource state before deciding whether to retry.

RefDeleteConflict.description: The branch or tag is referenced by an alias, or a conditional catalog conflict occurred. For a referenced target, delete or retarget every referencing alias before retrying deletion. Do not blindly retry an in-use target.

EmbeddingConfig.title: EmbeddingConfig
EmbeddingConfig.description: Native embedding configuration for vector fields.

model.description: Embedding model name. See /guides/collections/native-embeddings for the current supported providers and models.

sourceField.description: Legacy single-text source path in the original JSON. Use exactly one non-null sourceField or sources. Missing text is skipped; invalid values fail when inference is needed. An explicitly supplied vector takes precedence over inference.

dimensions.description: Optional model dimensions, resolved in stored metadata. OpenAI limits depend on the model. Cohere accepts 256, 512, 768, 1024, 1536 or 2048 and defaults to 2048.

similarity.description: Resolved vector similarity metric. Optional in requests and resolved in stored collection metadata.

sources.description: Ordered source mappings; field paths must be unique. Text sources are scalar strings. Cohere image sources are strings or flat string arrays, expanded in place to create one combined vector. Missing sources and empty image arrays are skipped. At most 16 effective parts, 8 images and 1 MiB decoded image bytes per input; each image is limited to 4,194,304 pixels. Images must be supported data URIs or public HTTPS URLs. URL, field-path, duplicate-path, format and byte/pixel validation remain server checks. OpenAI requires exactly one text source.

FieldDescription.title: FieldDescription
FieldDescription.description: Optional free-form explanation of what the field holds, returned in collection reads so agents and SDK users can discover field meanings. It never affects indexing and can be added, changed, or cleared on an existing field without reindexing. On PATCH, omitting it or sending null keeps the stored description, an empty string clears it, and any other value replaces it. Not accepted on the server-managed id field.

IndexConfigs.title: IndexConfigs

analyzers.description: Fixed analyzer presets for text fields; custom pipelines and analyzer options are not supported. The keyword analyzer does not change a text field into a keyword field. All 49 preset names are supported. See the Choose text analyzers guide for compatible SDK and tool versions. Use the lowercase names listed below. Duplicate names, including case variants, are rejected with HTTP 400. Defaults to ["standard"] when omitted. Each selected analyzer indexes the field separately; language detection is not automatic. An empty array does not use the default. See the Choose text analyzers guide for language selection, configuration examples, and the tradeoffs of combining analyzers.

managedEmbedding.description: Set to false or omit for vector fields with caller-provided values.

dimensions.description: Vector dimensions for vector fields with caller-provided values.

similarity.description: Vector similarity metric for vector fields with caller-provided values.

managedEmbedding.description: An embedding block enables native embeddings when this flag is omitted; explicit false is invalid. Normalized collection responses retain true.

oneOf.description: Types that do not need additional parameters.

IndexConfigs.description: Nonempty full schema. Collection updates preserve all existing fields and their settings while allowing new top-level fields and nested children at any depth. Removing or changing an existing field is rejected; only the optional description of a field may change. Collection responses include the server-managed top-level id field as {"type":"keyword"}. Requests may omit it or send exactly that configuration, so returned indexConfigs can be sent back unchanged; any other id configuration, id inside an object field, or other reserved internal field name is rejected.

FieldsSelector.description: An object to specify a list of field names to include and/or exclude in the result.

include.description: List of field names to include in the result.

exclude.description: List of field names to exclude in the result.

indexConfigs.description: Index schema of the default main branch, as a read-only summary like numDocs and dataUpdatedAt. Other branches carry their own schema: read it from GET /collections/{collectionName}/branches/{branchName}.

tags.description: Collection metadata tags. Up to five entries.

numPartitions.description: Total number of partitions including the default partition.

numDocs.description: Document count in the default main branch's committed head, not a sum across branches or the count of a selected ref.

snapshotRetentionInDays.description: Number of days to retain committed snapshots.

createdAt.description: Collection creation time as Unix epoch milliseconds.

updatedAt.description: Collection last update time as Unix epoch milliseconds.

dataUpdatedAt.description: Last data update time recorded in the default main branch's committed head, as Unix epoch milliseconds. Commits without data mutations retain the previous value, so this is not necessarily the latest head commit time. Absent before a committed head exists.

ConsistentRead.title: ConsistentRead
ConsistentRead.description: Overlay eligible inherited and own pending writes on the selected branch's committed snapshot. Defaults to false; ordinary branch reads use only the snapshot. Allowed for a branch or an alias that targets a branch; the alias is resolved when the request is admitted. Tag and tag-alias query/fetch reads internally include eligible fixed inherited writes, but reject true with 400. Pending bulk imports are excluded until materialized by a background build. Returns 429 if the eligible pending payload exceeds the consistent-read limit.

IncludeVectors.title: IncludeVectors
IncludeVectors.description: If your application need to include vector values in the response, set includeVectors to true.

RefContext.title: RefContext
RefContext.description: Read ref selector. A ref that does not exist returns 404 ResourceNotFound; an alias whose target is dangling returns 400 BadRequest.

asOf.description: Select the latest retained committed snapshot at or before this Unix epoch millisecond cutoff. Inherited and pending WAL are excluded; this is not exact-time WAL restore.

snapshotCommittedAt.description: Snapshot commit time as Unix epoch milliseconds, distinct from ref creation time and collection dataUpdatedAt.

branchId.description: Identity of the direct source branch at creation time.

name.description: Name of the direct source branch at creation time.

parentBranch.description: Fixed identity and name of the direct source branch, even when its selected snapshot originated on an ancestor or its head was empty. Explicitly null for main, branches created from tags, or when no parent was recorded. Historical metadata only: it does not prevent parent deletion, and recreating the parent's name does not change this identity.

headSnapshot.description: Current committed head. Explicitly null for an empty branch.

parentSnapshot.description: Fixed snapshot from which the branch was created, not the previous head. Explicitly null for main and branches created from an empty source, even after their head advances. This metadata does not extend snapshot retention.

createdAt.description: Branch creation time as Unix epoch milliseconds.

numDocs.description: Document count in this branch's committed head; 0 for an empty branch.

dataUpdatedAt.description: Last data update of this branch's committed head as Unix epoch milliseconds. Explicitly null for an empty branch.

snapshotId.description: Current published snapshot ID. Explicitly null before the first publication and may change as fixed writes are published.

snapshotCommittedAt.description: Current snapshot commit time as Unix epoch milliseconds. Explicitly null before the first publication.

createdAt.description: Tag creation time as Unix epoch milliseconds.

indexConfigs.description: Index schema pinned by the tag, including inherited WAL. With source.asOf, this is the selected snapshot's schema.

numDocs.description: Document count in the current published snapshot, or 0 before the first publication.

dataUpdatedAt.description: Last data update in the current snapshot as Unix epoch milliseconds. Explicitly null before the first publication.

dangling.description: Whether the bound target identity is missing. Document reads through a dangling alias return 400; GET /collections/{collectionName}/aliases/{aliasName} still returns the alias with null indexConfigs. Deletion of a non-default branch or a tag is blocked with 409 while aliases reference it.

createdAt.description: Alias creation time as Unix epoch milliseconds.

indexConfigs.description: Index schema of the target's version; null for a dangling alias.

size.description: Maximum buckets to return after global aggregation. Defaults to 10 when omitted or null.

buckets.description: Ordered by count descending, then keyword Unicode code point order ascending. A document contributes once per distinct indexed value. Missing or unindexed values have no bucket.

RerankConfig.description: Optional native reranking for this query, not a collection setting. Omitted or null preserves existing search behavior. LambdaDB manages provider credentials; no provider API key is supplied by the caller. Request validation, field types, UTF-8 byte limits, and size <= candidateSize are checked by the server.

model.description: Required reranking model; independent of the collection embedding model.

queryText.description: Required nonblank evaluation query, including for raw-vector or hybrid retrieval. At most 8 KiB UTF-8; never inferred from retrieval legs.

fields.description: Ordered, unique stored scalar string paths, using dotted paths for nested fields. Paths do not need index configs. If configured, leaves must be text or keyword and configured ancestors must be objects. Empty or blank path segments are invalid; arrays, objects, and non-string values are invalid, including on unindexed stored paths. Values are checked before provider dispatch. Missing/null values are skipped, but every candidate must have at least one nonblank selected value. Only these fields enter model input; top-level fields controls the response projection. Rendered candidate text is limited to 16 KiB UTF-8, and query plus all rendered candidates plus custom criteria to 256 KiB.

candidateSize.description: Upper bound on the globally merged and deduplicated rerank pool. Omitted or null defaults to max(50, size). Must satisfy size <= candidateSize <= 1000. Does not modify any knn.k and does not guarantee this many candidates.

onFailure.description: Omitted or null uses error. Provider timeout, rate limit, unavailable service, credential rejection, or invalid/incomplete scores follow this policy for the whole stage. returnOriginal keeps pre-rerank candidate order and search scores. Input/configuration, retrieval/hydration, authorization, quota, admission, and overall cancellation/deadline errors do not become fallback results.

criteria.description: TypeSafe/Jev only; Cohere requires omitted or null criteria. Distinct nonblank descriptions ordered from lowest to highest relevance. Omitted/null uses default-relevance-v1. Each description is limited to 2 KiB and the full list to 8 KiB UTF-8. Text is preserved exactly. Custom levels use uniformly spaced scores from 0 to 1; explicitly sending the default descriptions still selects custom scoring. Weights and thresholds are not supported.

RerankResponse.description: Present only when rerank was requested. Whole-stage metadata remains inline even when documents are downloaded through docsUrl.

resolvedModel.description: Resolved model identity, when reported by the provider. Omitted otherwise.

candidateCount.description: Actual unique candidates in the rerank stage before final size limiting, not the returned-document count.

scoredCount.description: Equals candidateCount on applied results; zero for skipped/fallback. Partial scores are never exposed.

took.description: Rerank stage milliseconds after candidate hydration, including preparation and ordering or failure handling; not the complete request duration.

criteriaVersion.description: Only on applied results. TypeSafe/Jev uses default-relevance-v1 or custom; Cohere uses cohere-relevance-v1.

reason.description: Only for skipped/fallback. skipped uses noCandidates; fallback uses a bounded provider failure reason.

field.description: Unique dotted path in the original stored JSON; no index declaration is required.

get.description: List all collections in an existing project, one page at a time in name order. A response with more collections to return carries nextPageToken; pass it as pageToken to get the next page, and omit pageToken for the first page. size and pageToken are the only query parameters; any other one, an out-of-range size, or an empty or malformed pageToken returns 400 BadRequest.

parameters.description: Max number of collections to return at once.

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description: Opaque token returned by the previous page. Do not decode or modify it. Omit it for the first page; an empty value is rejected.

200.description: A list of collections matched with a projectName.

nextPageToken.description: Opaque token for the next page.

On a branch or branch alias, consistentRead also includes pending ordinary writes. Tags and tag aliases always include their pending ordinary writes. Bulk imports become visible after publication. Later pages include currently visible documents after the cursor. Changes to a sort value can cause a document to be returned again or skipped.

sort.description: Order by up to four keyword, long, double, or datetime fields in the given order. Each object specifies one field and asc or desc. Ascending document ID breaks ties and is the default order when sort is omitted or null. For keyword arrays, asc selects the smallest indexed value and desc the largest. Missing keywords sort last for asc and first for desc. Missing numeric and datetime values sort as zero (Unix epoch for datetime).

filter.description: Filter applied before pagination. Supports queryString and nested bool filters. Vector and ranking query objects are not supported.

consistentRead.description: Include pending ordinary writes from the branch and its inherited history as of this page request. Bulk imports become visible after publication. Tags and aliases targeting tags reject true.

post.description: Update existing documents by ID with a strongly consistent read followed by a merged replacement. Omitted fields are preserved, nested objects are recursively merged, and arrays are replaced. Indexed fields reject null. A missing ID in the selected branch and partition rejects the whole request with 400 before submission. No document-version precondition is supported; concurrent updates can overwrite each other. The maximum supported payload size is 6MB.

docs.description: Documents to update; each must contain the existing document ID and, for partitioned documents outside __default__, its existing partition-field value. Omitted fields are preserved. Objects merge recursively; arrays and scalars replace existing values. Null is rejected for indexed fields and stored as JSON null for unindexed fields, not as a field deletion. For native embedding fields, an explicitly supplied vector takes precedence. Otherwise equivalent input reuses an existing vector, changed source input regenerates it, and removal of the last source removes an inherited vector. Metadata-only updates preserve direct vectors when raw source fields are unchanged.

post.description: Search a collection with a query and return the most similar documents. Optionally rerank globally merged candidates with a model provided by LambdaDB before the final size limit. Rerank is configured per query; omitted/null preserves existing behavior. See the Native reranking guide for candidate depth, score meaning, and failure policy.

size.description: Number of documents to return, from 0 to 1000. Defaults to 10 when omitted or null. Zero requires at least one facet; facet counts cover all matching documents regardless of this size. Rerank requires a positive size; this remains the final returned-document limit, distinct from candidateSize and each knn.k.

query.description: Query object. For native embedding vector fields, use knn.queryText or ordered knn.queryInputs parts with explicit type (text or image) and string value. Cohere accepts mixed parts, OpenAI one text part. A raw knn.queryVector is also accepted for native fields and skips inference. Each knn query requires exactly one non-null queryText, queryInputs or queryVector and has its own k from 1 to 1000, independent of size and candidateSize. Text and multimodal inputs require a native embedding vector field. queryInputs uses the same part, image and byte limits as document inputs. Each sparseVector.queryVector weight must be greater than 0 and at most 64; a weight outside that range returns 400. All automatic query inputs are prepared before the first provider call; Cohere preparation checks inference quota before retrieving images. Query structure and per-leg bounds are validated by the server. Omit or use null to match all documents. Facets support queryString and bool queries only; vector, sparse vector, and hybrid queries cannot be combined with facets. Bayesian fusion uses a top-level bayesian array of exactly two unboosted subqueries, with no nested fusion or boosts on Boolean descendants. See the Hybrid query guide for candidate budgets.

sort.description: List of field name, sort direction pairs. Omitted or null means no explicit sort. A non-null sort list, including an empty list, cannot be combined with rerank.

facets.description: Exact document counts by indexed keyword value. Keys are keyword field names, including dotted paths. Applies all query and partition filters and the selected ref. At most 10,000 distinct (field, value) buckets and 262,144 UTF-8 value bytes across requested fields; exceeding either bound returns 400 instead of partial counts. Separate memory admission limits return 400 when one request exceeds its estimated budget, or 429 when concurrent requests temporarily exhaust a budget. Request fewer fields or partitions for memory-limit errors; retry temporary 429 errors with backoff.

candidateSize.description: Required for top-level Bayesian fusion without rerank: 1 <= size <= candidateSize <= 1000. Controls retrieval and calibration depth per signal, independently of final size and each knn.k. With rerank, omit this field and use rerank.candidateSize. Other query types must omit it. Null is treated as omitted; query semantics and the cross-field size bound are validated by the server.

query.description: Must contain a scoring retrieval query; filter-only queries are rejected by the server.

maxScore.description: Maximum final score among returned documents. Applied reranking uses the final evaluation scores; fallback keeps search scores. Omitted for empty results or when no score is computed. Numeric zero is a valid maximum.

score.description: Final sorting score. Applied reranking returns a double-precision evaluation score in [0,1], not a relevance probability. Without reranking or on fallback, this remains the original retrieval/fusion score and is not constrained to [0,1]. Omitted when the query does not compute a score. Numeric zero is valid; retain precision.

retrievalScore.description: Original retrieval/fusion score, present only when reranking was applied. A sibling of score and doc, not a field inside doc. Omitted when reranking is not requested, is skipped, or falls back; preserve original precision.

post.description: Create a writable branch from a branch or tag in the same collection. Without source.asOf, creation pins the source snapshot (if any) and fixed inherited and pending WAL ranges without copying WAL or waiting for the source build. The new branch materializes those ranges independently; its ordinary reads remain snapshot-only, while direct consistentRead includes eligible pending writes. Omit source to use main. A branch created from a tag inherits the tag's pinned schema and all writes captured when the tag was created. Later writes to the original branch are excluded. Alias sources and tag sources with asOf return 400 BadRequest. For a branch source, source.asOf selects only the latest retained committed snapshot at or before the cutoff, excluding all pending and inherited WAL. An empty source branch is allowed, with parentBranch still recording the source branch. The response carries the new branch's inherited indexConfigs.

patch.description: Update the index schema of one branch. The change applies to this branch only; updating main also updates the collection's indexConfigs, which mirror main. The same additive rule as the collection route applies within the branch: indexConfigs must preserve the branch's complete existing schema (the server-managed id field may be included as returned or omitted), new fields may be added at any object depth, and a field description may be set, replaced, or cleared without reindexing. Concurrent additive updates of the same branch are merged. Only a branch can be updated: naming a tag or an alias returns 400 BadRequest. Promoting a branch's schema to main is a manual step: apply the same additive change to main.

post.description: Restore a branch's data and index schema from a tag in the same collection. The branch keeps its identity. When the tag has a published snapshot, the branch records a new committed snapshot. Ordinary reads show the restored snapshot; consistentRead also includes eligible inherited WAL and new writes. Bulk writes appear after build. When the tag has no published snapshot yet, the branch head becomes empty and the branch inherits the tag's fixed WAL, like a branch created from that tag: no snapshot is recorded, headSnapshot is null in the response and in the branch details, ordinary reads and document listing return no documents until a build publishes the inherited writes, and consistentRead includes the eligible inherited writes. The rollback time is not recorded, so source.asOf on this branch returns 400 for cutoffs between the branch's last snapshot before the rollback and the first snapshot published after it, including after that snapshot is published. Writes admitted before rollback may still complete on the previous stream. Each request resolves the current branch by name. Sending the request again performs another rollback and can undo intervening writes. If two requests attempt to replace the same active WAL stream, one succeeds and the other returns 409.

headSnapshot.description: New head committed on the destination branch by this rollback. Explicitly null when the tag had no published snapshot, which leaves the branch head empty.

tagWithoutSnapshot.summary: The tag had no published snapshot

post.description: Create a fixed, read-only reference from a branch or tag in the same collection. Without source.asOf, capture the source's published snapshot (if any) and remaining WAL through the fork point. A tag can be created before the first snapshot if it inherits pending WAL. Background builds may partially materialize those ranges into the tag's own snapshot without changing the source. Ordinary query, fetch, and document listing include eligible inherited writes, including through an alias targeting the tag. Bulk imports must be published to be visible. Tags and aliases targeting tags reject consistentRead=true. A tag source copies its fixed state, not a chain of tags. Alias sources are not allowed. source.asOf is valid only for a branch source and pins only the latest retained committed snapshot at or before the cutoff, with no pending or inherited WAL. Omit source to use main. A source with neither a snapshot nor pending WAL, or unavailable asOf history, returns 400. The response carries the tag's pinned indexConfigs.
